title: Belarus conference to take place in Rīga
summary_full: On Friday, 4th September from 10.00 to 13.30, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will host an international conference titled 'Conference on Belarus 2026'. The event is organised jointly by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Latvian Institute of International Affairs.
